meta.name: deepchem
meta.description: Molecular ML with diverse featurizers and pre-built datasets. Use for property prediction (ADMET, toxicity) with traditional ML or GNNs when you want extensive featurization options and MoleculeNet benchmarks. Best for quick experiments with pre-trained models, diverse molecular representations. For graph-first PyTorch workflows use torchdrug; for benchmark datasets use pytdc.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测分子性质，加速化学与药物研发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速评估大量分子的ADMET和毒性等性质
copy.tagline_en: Predict molecular properties to accelerate drug discovery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly evaluate ADMET and toxicity properties for many molecules

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 DeepChem 库处理分子数据:读取 SMILES/SDF/蛋白质序列,转成机器学习特征,切分数据集,训练传统机器学习或图神经网络模型,并用 MoleculeNet 基准数据评估,还能微调预训练模型。
howto.when: 当用户要求对分子做性质预测(如溶解度、毒性)、用 MoleculeNet 数据集训练模型,或需要把分子转成特征时,技能会自动介入。

say.text: 用 DeepChem 预测 CCO 的溶解度。
say.note: 会走溶解度预测流程并返回结果。

say.text: 在 Tox21 上训练一个 GCN 分类模型。
say.note: 加载基准数据并训练评估。

say.text: 把 molecules.csv 按 scaffold 切分,训练随机森林。
say.note: 按分子骨架切分防止泄漏。

howto.what_en: Claude uses DeepChem to load molecular data, featurize molecules, split data, train ML/GNN models, run MoleculeNet benchmarks, and fine-tune pretrained models.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to predict molecular properties (e.g., solubility, toxicity), train models on MoleculeNet datasets, or convert molecules to ML features.

say_en.text: Use DeepChem to predict the solubility of CCO.
Train a GCN classifier on Tox21.
Split molecules.csv by scaffold and train a random forest.
say_en.note: Uses scaffold splitting to prevent leakage.
